package rulefixtures

	"encoding/json"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_serialization_json_marshal_for_deep_equal: Layer: Serialization and deserialization. Flag json.Marshal used only to compare structures or build equality keys.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type Rule592PositiveRecord struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Count int `json:"count"` }

func scenario592Positive(values []Rule592PositiveRecord) (int, error) {
	total := 0
	for i := 1; i < len(values); i++ {
		left, err := json.Marshal(values[i-1])
		if err != nil { return 0, err }
		right, err := json.Marshal(values[i])
		if err != nil { return 0, err }
		if bytes.Equal(left, right) {
			total++
		}
	}
	return total, nil
}
